title: WATCH How God Will Bless You When You Obey Him (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: have you ever been lost while driving somewhere new you keep making turns thinking you're going the right way but you only seem to get more lost it's so frustrating the only way to get unlost is to retrace your steps back to the point where you made the wrong turn in life we can get lost too wandering away from God through disobedience but the good news is obedience is like a map that leads us right back to the heart of God Psalm

128 verse 1. blessed are all who fear the lord who walk in obedience to him today God wants me to reveal to you the power of obedience to God in your life so stick around because I am going to pray a powerful prayer with you calling on God to bless you abundantly in the name of Jesus so watch until the end and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer Now The Godly life is a journey of following God

in obedience as children God calls us to walk in obedience to his word and his commands this is for our own protection and blessing obedience brings us closer to the heart of the father Disobedience leads us astray into danger distress and sometimes even death in Deuteronomy 11 verses 26 to 27 Moses presents the people of Israel with a choice he tells them I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse the blessing if you obey the commands of the

Lord your God that I am giving you today the curse if you disobey the commands of the Lord your God my friends the same Choice stands before us today if we walk in obedience to God's principles and precepts it will lead to amazing blessing in our lives but if we Rebel and choose to disobey it will block the flow of God's blessing and protection over us the consistent diligent choice to obey God draws us closer to him I have been asked

many times how can I get to hear God how can I hear God clearer from communing with God I learned that obedience is that one thing you need to do if you wish to hear God speak to you the holy spirit said to me once if I could get people to be obedient I could get them to achieve anything my friend's Disobedience to God is what's holding you back obedience is an Act of Faith it is also an act that demonstrates

your trust in God in ancient times people used to offer sacrifices to God as a way to seek forgiveness for their wrongdoings or sins they believe that by sacrificing something valuable like an animal it would make things right between them and God however over time God revealed through his messages that what he truly desires is not just these offerings but rather obedience and a sincere heart in the Old Testament of the Bible specifically in the book of First Samuel 15 22

God's preference for obedience is clear when he tells the prophet Samuel as the Lord is great Delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as in obeying the voice of the Lord behold to obey is better than sacrifice and to heed than the fat of rams this teaches us that God values a person's willingness to follow his commands and live in a way that honors him more than the physical act of offering sacrifices the ultimate demonstration of God's preference for obedience over sacrifice

is seen in the New Testament through the life and sacrifice of Jesus Christ in the book of Hebrews 9 verse 11 to 14 it is explained that Jesus became the final and perfect sacrifice for Humanity's sin he shed Blood on the cross symbolizes the New Covenant between God and Mankind offering Eternal forgiveness and Reconciliation this event signifies that God himself provided the ultimate solution for sin it highlighted that obedience to God's Will and embracing the gift of Salvation through Jesus is

what truly matters through obedience we experience more of God's presence favor and generosity in our daily lives today I want to explore three key blessings that obedience to God brings into our lives one obedience draws us closer to God through experiencing his presence two obedience draws us closer to God through receiving his favor three obedience draws us closer to God through reaping His blessings now let's explore these beautiful benefits of living a lifestyle of obedience to our good father my friends

let's look at the first key blessings obedience draws us closer to God through experiencing his presence our obedience and God's presence are intimately connected when we walk in obedience to God's principles in his word we experience the Manifest presence of God in our lives through obedience we open the door for God's very Spirit to dwell in Us in John 14 23 Jesus replied anyone who loves me will obey my teaching my father will love them and we will come to them

and make our home with them here we see Jesus is measuring or quantifying our love based on our obedience to his words now you can see that obedience is important if you wish to invite the Lord into your life when we love and Obey Christ God make his home in our hearts now why does God promise his presence to the obedient I believe there are two key reasons first God dwells close to the obedient heart because he knows he is welcome

there it's like visiting a friend's home you feel comfortable staying a long time when your friend welcomes you in but if your friend is always breaking promises to you and ignoring your words you don't want to stay you know you're not welcome in the same way when we obey God it shows him that he is wanted and welcome in our lives our obedience lays down a welcome mat for the Lord's presence second God dwells close to the obedient heart because obedience

requires trust to obey God especially when his commands don't make sense to us requires deep trust in his characterized wisdom Psalm 2 verse 14 says the Lord confides in those who fear Him he makes his Covenant known to them dear friends God draws near to those who walk in Godly fear and radical Trust his presence is the reward for our faith in him James 4 verse 8 draw near to God and He will draw near to you I encourage you today

walk in Greater obedience to God's words in Scripture as you do you will experience the depths of his presence like never before the holy spirit will become your daily companion and closest Confidant now that takes me to the second key blessings obedience draws us closer to God through receiving his favor now in addition to experiencing God's presence obedience to the Lord also ushers in his Supernatural favor over our lives The Book of Proverbs 2 verses 21 to 22 says for the

upright will live in the land and the blameless will remain in it but the wicked will be cut off from the land and the Unfaithful will be torn from it now this blamelessness is only possible because of Jesus Colossians 1 verse 22 says in the body of his flesh through death to present you holy and blameless and above reproach in his sight God's favor rests upon the upright and those who seek to do his will now not because you might have

sinned in the past that means you are disqualified from God's favor that's the beauty about Jesus he is gracious and merciful if you repented meaning that you turn from your sinful ways first John 1 verse 9. if we confess our sins he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness my friends all we need to do is to obey God to walk in the full favor of God's blessings I like to think of

the favor of God as an umbrella over us when we walk in obedience to God's principles we come under the shelter and shade of his favor even When Storms Come this umbrella protects and Comforts us we have a confidence that God Is Watching Over Us we are at peace knowing we dwell in his care in the secret place of the most high and under the shadow of the almighty God however when we live in rebellion and Disobedience we step out from

under this covering we are exposed to the harsh elements and ferocious storms of this life we become battered and bruised lacking protection the faithful obedient walk under an open Heaven the blessings of God flow freely into their lives doors swing wide open for them people are compelled to show them favor promotion and prosperity seem to chase them down this is the favor of God in action on the other hand the disobedient often find closed doors at every turn opportunities dry up

people that used to be a good source of help desert you your life seemed plagued with constant Misfortune and bad breaks this is The Curse Of Living outside of God's favor if you feel like you've been facing nothing but closed doors and bad breaks examine your life have you been rebelling against God's commands have you been ignoring the promptings of his spirit I urge you to return to obedience today and reinvite God's favor into your life line your life up with

his word and watch his open doors swing wide before you now this takes me to my third key Point obedience draws us closer to God through reaping His blessings a lifestyle of obedience leads to reaping all the blessings of God while we cannot earn our Salvation obedience to Christ is rewarded with spiritual and physical blessings Deuteronomy 28 lays out in detail the many blessings God promises for those who diligently obey him let's do a quick flyover of some of these blessings

verse 3 blessed in the city and Country verse 4 blessed with children crops and livestock verse 6. blessed when you come in and go out and verse 7. Lord will grant you victory over enemies thus 8. blessed with prosperity in all you undertake verse 11. blessed with prosperity and success verse 12. the Lord will open the Heavens to send rain in season and the list goes on and on God promises to richly bless the obedient in every area of life family

finances career you cannot out give God when you walk and surrender to him he Delights to pour out his blessings from on high the obedient life is the blessed life God sees your faithfulness and honors it he sees your Devotion to obeying his word and following the leading of his spirit as the good father he desires to reward his children who bring him Joy through their obedience even in times of trial and difficulty the obedient can rest in Hope Romans 8

verse 28 says for we know God works all things for the good of those who love him and second Corinthians 4 verse 17. compliments it by saying for our light affliction which is but for a moment is working for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of Glory dear friends no matter what you face obedience positions you to receive Supernatural blessings from your father's hands so today no matter what you are facing choose obedience to God offer God your willing

heart fully surrendered to him determine to walk in alignment with Christ today through obeying the promptings of the Holy Spirit if you haven't yet invited Jesus into your heart this could be your moment of salvation as you do you will draw closer to the blessings in favor of God with each step you will experience his presence in a profound and transformational way I must tell you this in my own walk with God obedience to God has been one of my greatest

weapons against the enemy the importance of obedience should never be understated now there is a Common Thread that runs throughout almost every story of victory in the scriptures and that Common Thread is obedience yes nothing fancy just plain and faithful obedience to God obedience to Divine guidance played a pivotal role in achieving victory over enemies in various biblical accounts King jehoshaphat's humble obedience marked by fasting and worship led to a miraculous intervention where enemy forces turned against each other resulting in

their defeat Esther's Brave obedience driven by faith and determination exposed a plot against her people and ultimately led to their deliverance from destruction similarly the story of David and Goliath highlights the power of obedience in facing overwhelming odds David's unwavering trust in God's guidance combined with his obedience to face the giant with a sling and stone resulted in a surprising victory over the Philistine champion in the case of naaman's healing from leprosy his initial resistance gave way to obedience as he

followed Elisha's simple instructions to wash in the Jordan River seven times this Act of Faith led to his complete healing furthermore Elisha's obedience to God's leading guided him to outmaneuver the Syrian Army through unconventional tactics showcasing the significance of obedience in overcoming adversaries each of these stories underscores the transformative impact of obedience in our life it should be obvious now don't you see how powerful obedience to God can be you should never forget the three key blessings that obedience to God

brings to your life one obedience allows us to experience God's presence in a real and intimate way he makes his home in the life of the obedient to obedience ushers in the Supernatural favor of God we come under his Divine umbrella of blessing and protection and three obedience leads to reaping all the blessings of God he Delights to reward those who Faithfully walk with him let it be your life's mission to walk in obedience to God what's your relationship with the

Holy Spirit grow from strength to strength with willing heart and obedient hands you will draw closer to the heart of God each day you will experience his presence favor and blessings in New Heights my dear friends the obedient life is the blessed life now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us

pray to our gracious Lord dear heavenly father most righteous and gracious Lord you are the only true God King of Kings and Lord of lords I exalt and worship your holy name I come before you with a heart full of Thanksgiving and praise acknowledging your sovereignty and love Lord Jesus I ask for your mercy and forgiveness for all the times that I have been disobedient today I thank you for the precious gift of obedience and the profound blessings that flow from

it Lord we accept and embrace your calling to obedience Lord instill in me a steadfast desire to obey your word helped me to overcome my human inclinations and surrender my will to you may my obedience be an expression of my love and trust in you a reflection of my faith that you have our best interests at heart as I walk in obedience I ask that you fill me with your Holy Spirit loving father be not far from me but Draw Me

Closer to You that I may feel your loving embrace touch my heart and mind and help me to hear your voice clearly when you speak precious Lord I pray for your guidance and wisdom in all aspects of my life be a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path Lord help me to discern your will and make choices that align with your Divine Purpose grant me the strength to resist the Temptations that seek to divert me from your intended

path let not my enemies have victory over me I trust in your faithfulness to keep me from all harm almighty God I lift up our family and friends who may be struggling with obedience Lord touch the heart of all my loved ones that they too will have obedient Hearts to your word Lord help us to persevere and grant us courage and deliverance from all our challenges let us all experience the truth that your commands are not burdensome but are meant to

lead us into the Abundant Life pour out your blessings upon us as we obey your word bless our relationships our work our health and every aspect of Our Lives May we experience the Fulfillment that comes from walking hand in hand with you Lord I also pray for those of us who have yet to embrace the beauty of obedience soften their hearts Lord and reveal to them the immeasurable joy that Springs forth from following your ways may they come to know the

profound peace that only comes from a life lived in harmony with your divine plan in times of difficulty or uncertainty remind me of the blessings that obedience brings may I find strength in knowing that I am faithful to your promises and that my obedience is an offering that Delights Your Heart Lord as we surrender to you who perfectly modeled obedience may your Holy Spirit Empower us to walk Faithfully in your ways Lord I Thank You For Hearing and answering my prayer

in Jesus precious name I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word Haman in the comment section below you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your support you're blessed to be a blessing

please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comment section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory and we also invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us start praying for you right now to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus and we want you to know that even if you don't see

a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that we did not pray for you rest assured we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all thank you
